name: VirtIO Balloon

operations.name: read_balloon_magic
operations.desc: Read VirtIO magic value from MMIO BAR0
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xC040
mov eax, [ebx + 0x00]
ret

probe_asm:
BITS 32

    mov eax, 0xc040      ; Base MMIO address
    mov eax, [eax]       ; Read magic at offset 0x00
    
    ret
